privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This privacy policy explains what personal data LUX Vision collects through this website, how it is used, and what rights you have regarding it.
privacyPolicy.controllerText: The controller of your personal data is LUX Vision, a sole proprietorship based in Krk, Croatia. For any questions regarding data protection, you can contact us through the contact form on this site or at lkosic.photo@gmail.com.
dataCollected: The content of the message you send us
IP address, for the purpose of preventing misuse of the contact form
A record of your consent to data processing, together with the time the message was sent
privacyPolicy.purposeText: We collect your data solely to respond to your inquiry submitted through the contact form. We do not use your data for marketing purposes or share it with third parties.
privacyPolicy.retentionTitle: How Long We Keep Your Data
privacyPolicy.retentionText: We keep your data for as long as the purpose for which it was collected still applies, or until you request its deletion.
privacyPolicy.cookiesIntro: This site uses a minimal number of cookies, strictly for functional purposes. We do not use cookies for analytics or marketing tracking.
privacyPolicy.cookieAuth: Authentication cookie — used only when an administrator logs into the site's management dashboard, to maintain a secure session.
privacyPolicy.cookieLocale: Language cookie — remembers your language selection (Croatian/English) during your visit.
privacyPolicy.rightsIntro: Regarding your personal data, you have the right to:
rights: Access the personal data we hold about you
Request deletion of your personal data
Restrict the processing of your data
Request the transfer of your data to another organization
Object to the processing of your data
privacyPolicy.contactText: If you wish to exercise any of the rights listed above, please contact us through the contact form or at lkosic.photo@gmail.com. We will respond to your request as soon as possible.
privacyPolicy.changesText: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We recommend checking it periodically to stay informed of any changes.

about.title: Luka — LUX Vision
about.paragraph1: Photography and videography began as a hobby for me, but over time they turned into a passion and eventually a profession, allowing me to do what I love while preserving moments that matter.
about.paragraph2: The name LUX comes from the Latin word for light, while also being inspired by my own name. Vision represents the way I see the world, as well as the stories and emotions I strive to preserve through my work.
about.paragraph3: I prefer natural light, real environments, and honest emotion over posed perfection. Whether I'm shooting weddings, events, or personal creative projects, the goal is always the same: to tell a story that feels authentic, emotional, and timeless.
about.quote: Do what you love, and love what you do.

aboutPage.title: Luka Kosić
aboutPage.intro: Hi, I'm Luka, a photographer and videographer from the island of Krk, Croatia and the person behind LUX Vision.
aboutPage.paragraph1: For me, photography and videography began as a hobby, but over time they turned into a passion and eventually a profession, allowing me to do what I love while preserving moments that matter.
aboutPage.paragraph2: The name LUX comes from the Latin word for light, while also being inspired by my own name, Luka. Vision represents not only the way I see the world, but also the stories and emotions I strive to preserve through my work.
aboutPage.paragraph3: I came into this industry because I started noticing how quickly moments disappear, the way people laugh when they forget the camera is there, the quiet pauses between words, the atmosphere of a place that can never be repeated in exactly the same way again. I prefer working with natural light, real environments, and unposed situations whenever possible. I'm drawn to simplicity, clean compositions, honest emotions and a cinematic approach that enhances reality rather than replacing it. I pay attention to small details, to people's energy, and to how light changes a scene in seconds. I aim for honesty, atmosphere, and meaning. Whether I'm shooting weddings, events, or personal creative projects, the goal is always the same: to tell stories that feel authentic, emotional, and timeless.
aboutPage.paragraph4: LUX Vision is not just about photos or videos, it's about memories and moments. It's about how something felt in a specific moment of time, and being able to relive that feeling years later through photos or videos.
aboutPage.quote: Do what you love, and love what you do.
